tests.name: Small tickets
tests.rule: Median transfer under $100 and at least half of transfers under $100

tests.name: Wallet-to-wallet use
tests.rule: At least 40% of transfers are wallet-to-wallet (no contract on either side)

tests.name: Not trading-dominated
tests.rule: DEX + Intents + lending/perps carry under 50% of volume

tests.name: Decoupled from volatility
tests.rule: |Spearman rho| between daily volume and NEAR |daily return| under 0.3

tests.name: Broad-based value
tests.rule: Largest 1% of transfers carry under 50% of volume

tests.name: Steady flow
tests.rule: Coefficient of variation of daily transfer count under 0.5

sensitivity.rule: wallet-to-wallet transfers where neither wallet appears in 10+ sampled transfers

intents.hub_rule: solver-* name, 5+ token_diff without referral, or 10+ sampled Intents stablecoin events
solver-* name, 5+ token_diff without referral, or 10+ sampled Intents stablecoin events
